title: geko --specialize route facts (one run configuration)
description: Written by 'geko route-facts', read by 'geko --specialize --route-facts'. A fact counts only when evidence[fact] is a non-empty list; an absent or unproven fact is unknown and never assumed. --specialize reads run_configuration, calls and, for a configuration without calls, zero_verified, thin, matmul_count and per_process; the other fields are provenance.

run_configuration.description: Name of the --workload-log configuration directory these facts belong to; when absent the file name without .json is used.

calls.description: One entry per call identity. Empty when the producer stopped (see stops): every call of the configuration is then refused.

matmul_count.description: rocblaslt_matmul calls in the mask-16 API trace.

mask128_call_count.description: Sum of call_count over the mask-128 trace.

thin.description: Fewer than two distinct call identities.

zero_verified.description: The configuration provably made no matmul call (zero mask-128 calls, every API process created a handle and made no matmul, no stops).

runtime_route.description: Configuration-level runtime-route proof from both runs' run.json/engine.log (complete, clean, env_values recorded, process_inventory consistent with the logs, API run bound to the trace run). --specialize requires proven: true with evidence, also for a configuration without calls.

reason.description: What evidence is missing when proven is false.

per_process.description: Per process id: API function name -> number of calls in the mask-16 trace.

stops.description: Observations that break the proof (e.g. api-count-mismatch, output-amax, nonordinary-api, pinned-index, tuning-override, tunableop, missing-heuristic, bias-axis, nonordinary-trace, run-incomplete, run-mode, run-mask, run-unclean, run-binding, inventory-stray-log, inventory-missing-log, inventory-empty-log).

identity.description: The call identity exactly as the mask-128 trace logged it (every logged identity field, as strings; solution_index, solution_Name, kernel_name and call_count excluded).

call_route.description: Accepted: 'ordinary matmul API'. Any other string is a non-ordinary route (grouped GEMM, device args, hipblaslt-ext, RocRoller, ...) and the call is refused.

bias_axis.description: Accepted: 'M'. Any other value with bias enabled is refused; null or unproven keeps the bias general.

output_amax.description: Accepted: false (no amax output, with evidence). true, null, unproven or a non-boolean value refuses the call.

runtime_route.description: Accepted: 'hipBLASLt heuristic' (both runs' run.json/engine.log show no TunableOp, tuning override or pinned solution index, and bind the API run to the trace run). Missing, null or any other value refuses the call.

evidence.description: Per fact (call_route, bias_axis, output_amax, runtime_route, identity) the evidence records; a fact without a non-empty list is unknown.
